text: Record an expense with payer, amount, description, participants
Expense is split equally among participants
Expenses persisted in a JSON file and survive between invocations
Show each person's balance (paid minus owed)
Compute a settlement plan of transfers that settles all balances
Settlement uses a greedy algorithm aiming for minimum number of transfers
Invalid input (non-positive/non-numeric amount, empty participants) rejected with error, not crash or silent corruption
Money handled precisely (no float drift; balances sum to zero, rounding of uneven splits handled)
